# Power summary (generated by scripts/14_power_summary.py — do not edit by hand)

Margin = adaptive minus best coverage baseline (or as named). `p` = cluster-level sign-flip test (study clusters); Holm-adjusted within each experiment and across all margins. Cluster CI resamples whole studies; stratified = equal-weight mean over tissues. **P** marks the pre-specified primary family (Holm (primary) column).

Power floor: with 18 independent units the smallest attainable exact p is 7.6e-06; Holm needs p < 0.0021 for the smallest primary p (24 primary margins) and < 0.00064 across all 78.
